facts.fact: The Digital Government Strategy states the Government of Malawi has developed an ICT Policy and National ICT Master and Strategic Plans, and carried out an ICT sector review during 2013-2017; no adoption date is given, so the document's published date is used.
The strategy's foreword says it will assist the Ministry of Information in implementing the targets in the National ICT Policy.
The strategy lists a medium-term action P9, owned by the Ministry of Information and Department of E-Government, to update the National ICT Policy, and an in-house review of it in its project table.
